items.coder_A: has_eligible_candidate false (excluded_intervention_type), uncertain: IMV-001 antisense oligonucleotide component
items.reason: IGV-001 is registered as one combination product, "an autologous cell immunotherapy" that "combines personalized whole tumor-derived cells with an antisense oligonucleotide (IMV-001) in implantable biodiffusion chambers"; the ASO is a component of the cell product and is never given or tested on its own, so the product is an excluded cell therapy/vaccine. Agreed coding stands.

items.coder_B: has_eligible_candidate false (excluded_intervention_type), uncertain: oligonucleotide component could be pharmacological
items.reason: Same product: the only investigational intervention is "IGV-001 Cell Immunotherapy" (vs placebo chambers); temozolomide and RT are SOC in both arms. By analogy with D30-R3/R4 (components that serve an excluded therapy are part of it) the ASO is not a separate candidate.

note: IMV-001 built into the IGV-001 cell product is part of the excluded therapy under D31-B8 (settles the former open point). cns5_terminology (priority 3, A historical vs B unclear): proposed historical because inclusion reads "WHO GRADE III or Grade IV GBM" with no IDH requirement (grade IV glioma without IDH, D27C).
